factories.name: newGetUserStep
factories.description: Read one user account by object ID or user principal name.

inputSchema.description: GetUserInput identifies one account to read.

userKey.description: UserKey is the account's object ID or its user principal name, such as ada.lovelace@contoso.com.

factories.name: newListUsersStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of accounts in the tenant, optionally filtered with an OData filter or a search expression.

inputSchema.description: ListUsersInput selects one page of accounts in the tenant. Leave every field blank to list all accounts in Microsoft Graph's default order.

filter.description: Filter is an OData $filter expression, such as accountEnabled eq false or startsWith(userPrincipalName,'ada'). Operators Microsoft documents as advanced, such as endsWith and ne, also need UsesAdvancedQuery.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 999 accounts; zero uses the connection's listUsersPageSize.

pageToken.description: PageToken is the NextPageToken of the previous page. It carries the original query, so Filter, Search, and PageSize must be blank when it is set; keep UsesAdvancedQuery as it was.

search.description: Search is a $search expression including its double quotes, such as "displayName:Ada"; it always uses Microsoft's eventually consistent index, so a just-created account may be missing.

usesAdvancedQuery.description: UsesAdvancedQuery sends ConsistencyLevel: eventual with $count=true, which Microsoft requires for advanced filters; results then come from an index that can lag recent changes.

factories.name: newCreateUserStep
factories.description: Create one enabled account with a generated password nobody receives that must be changed at the next sign-in, tagged with a stable key, so a repeated Step returns the account it created instead of a duplicate.

inputSchema.description: CreateUserInput describes one enabled account to create. The connector generates the initial password itself: no password is accepted, returned, stored, or logged.

department.description: Department is the optional department, at most 64 characters.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the address-book name, at most 256 characters; blank joins GivenName and Surname.

givenName.description: GivenName is the optional first name, at most 64 characters.

jobTitle.description: JobTitle is the optional job title, at most 128 characters.

mailNickname.description: MailNickname is the mail alias, at most 64 characters; blank uses the part of UserPrincipalName before the @.

provisioningKey.description: ProvisioningKey optionally identifies one logical account across Step executions, such as an HR hire ID. It is 1 to 128 letters, digits, and . _ : - characters; blank uses the Step's Call ID.

surname.description: Surname is the optional family name, at most 64 characters.

usageLocation.description: UsageLocation is an optional two-letter ISO 3166 country code, such as US, which Microsoft requires before a license can be assigned.

userPrincipalName.description: UserPrincipalName is the new sign-in name in one of the tenant's verified managed domains, such as ada.lovelace@contoso.com: at most 64 letters, digits, and ' . - _ ! # ^ ~ before the @, at most 113 characters in all.

factories.name: newDisableUserStep
factories.description: Block sign-in for one account by setting accountEnabled to false, keeping its data; disabling a disabled account changes nothing.

inputSchema.description: DisableUserInput identifies one account whose sign-in to block.

userKey.description: UserKey is the account's object ID or its user principal name.

factories.name: newEnableUserStep
factories.description: Restore sign-in for one account by setting accountEnabled to true; enabling an enabled account changes nothing.

inputSchema.description: EnableUserInput identifies one account whose sign-in to restore.

userKey.description: UserKey is the account's object ID or its user principal name.

factories.name: newRevokeSignInSessionsStep
factories.description: Invalidate every refresh token and browser session cookie issued to one account so it must sign in again everywhere; repeating it only moves the cutoff time forward.

inputSchema.description: RevokeSignInSessionsInput identifies one account whose sign-in sessions to revoke.

userKey.description: UserKey is the account's object ID or its user principal name.

factories.name: newAddUserToGroupStep
factories.description: Add one account as a direct member of a security or Microsoft 365 group; an existing membership is confirmed and reported instead of failing.

inputSchema.description: AddUserToGroupInput adds one account to one group.

groupId.description: GroupID is the group's object ID, a GUID shown at https://entra.microsoft.com > Entra ID > Groups > the group > Overview.

userId.description: UserID is the account's object ID, such as the ID createUser or getUser returned.

factories.name: newRemoveUserFromGroupStep
factories.description: Remove one account's direct membership from a group; a membership that is already gone is reported as removed.

inputSchema.description: RemoveUserFromGroupInput removes one account's direct membership from one group.

groupId.description: GroupID is the group's object ID, a GUID.

userId.description: UserID is the account's object ID.
